Container.Name: naviproxy
Container.Overview: NaviProxy is an intelligent music proxy between third-party applications (Symfonium, Feishin, DSub, Ultrasonic) and your Navidrome music server. It features multi-source concurrent search (Tidal, Spotify, Apple Music, Deezer, Debrid, Usenet), quality-based threshold filtering, and simultaneous background library caching into your Navidrome storage directory.

Config.Name: Web UI & API Port
Config.Description: Web UI & Subsonic API proxy port

Config.Name: Music Library Path
Config.Description: Shared Navidrome music directory where downloaded tracks are persisted and scanned

Config.Name: AppData Config Storage
Config.Description: Persistent configuration and plugin credentials directory

Config.Name: Navidrome Server URL
Config.Description: Full URL to your Navidrome server instance

Config.Name: Navidrome Username
Config.Description: Navidrome username for local library checks

Config.Name: Navidrome Auth Token / Salt
Config.Description: Navidrome auth token or user password

Config.Name: Redis Cache URL
Config.Description: Redis cache URL for L2 sub-millisecond search caching (optional)

Config.Name: Download Subfolder
Config.Description: Container path for saving newly downloaded audio tracks

Config.Name: Minimum Audio Quality
Config.Description: Minimum audio quality threshold (LOW_MP3_128, MID_MP3_256, HIGH_MP3_320, CD_FLAC_16_44, HIRES_FLAC_24_96, HIRES_FLAC_24_192)
